svg.title: Plans in the Planen occasions calendar
svg.desc: Compact dark reference: November and December months of the occasions calendar. Dated Plans get a short blue bar on their day and in the month band, occasions keep a dot. Rows under the month list Plans with the Planen symbol, their time and the word Plan; a discreet Plan shows only its list title with a lock.
